title: What can you do on the tee?
question: Which of these actions are allowed on the teeing area before your first shot? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Evening out uneven ground for a better stance.
Pulling up loose grass that might affect your shot.
Moving the tee-markers to change your starting spot.

explanation: You can prepare the surface by smoothing the ground and removing natural loose items like grass or twigs, but must never move the tee-markers.
imagePrompt: A teen golfer on the teeing area, picking up a twig and pulling some loose grass, clearly within the correct area with untouched tee-markers.
imageAlt: Teen golfer tidying grass and removing a twig on the tee with tee-markers visible.

issues: Tee markers could be a more common or standard color for authenticity—typically white, yellow, blue, or red.
imageVerification.repairPrompt: Depict tee markers in a standard golf color such as white, yellow, blue, or red for added realism.
